verdict.rationale: Numeral ships an MCP server and Claude skills that let external AI agents query account data (nexus status, filings, transactions) and integrate the API, but there is no evidence of a first-party AI assistant that answers substantive tax-law questions ('is this taxable in this state', 'why did this invoice tax this way') with citations to a rule base — the MCP tools surface account state, not tax-rule explanations with sourcing.
